name: tfl_network_daily_journeys
title: TfL network-wide Underground and bus journeys per day
description: Total journeys per day across London's Underground and bus networks from 1 January 2019, as published by TfL alongside its station footfall series (same Network Demand folder, same overlapping yearly and rolling two-year files rewritten in place about weekly). This table resolves the overlaps into one row per day; the raw zip preserves each week's files exactly as published. Powered by TfL Open Data.

licenses.name: TfL-Transport-Data-Licence
licenses.title: TfL Transport Data Service licence (based on OGL v2.0) — attribution: "Powered by TfL Open Data"

sources.title: Transport for London — Network Demand open data (crowding.data.tfl.gov.uk, folder 'Network Demand', Journeys_*.csv)

update_cadence: TfL rewrites the current file roughly weekly, with data to about a week before upload, and is refreshed here weekly.
caveats: Counts are rounded by TfL to the nearest thousand journeys.
These are TfL's journey estimates, not station taps: they do not reconcile with summing tfl_station_footfall (which counts entries and exits at gate lines, including some non-Underground stations).

TfL does not document exactly which modes are inside 'Tube' (e.g. whether Elizabeth line journeys are included) — compare against TfL's period-level 'journeys by type of transport' series before relying on the split.
Covid-19: 2020 and 2021 (and early 2022) reflect lockdowns and recovery; do not use them as a baseline.

Overlaps between TfL's files are resolved by taking each day from the file covering the latest period; source_file records which file each row came from. Recent days are subject to small revisions in later weekly uploads.
TfL keeps no history of superseded figures — earlier versions are preserved only by this dataset's commit history and monthly archive-YYYY-MM tags.
Attribution required by the licence: "Powered by TfL Open Data".

resources.name: daily_journeys_parquet
resources.description: One row per day, overlaps between TfL's files resolved (latest period wins), sorted by travel_date. Derived from the raw zip, which is authoritative.

fields.name: travel_date
fields.description: Date of travel, ISO yyyy-mm-dd (TfL publishes yyyymmdd).

fields.name: day_of_week
fields.description: Day name, Monday to Sunday; always consistent with travel_date.

fields.name: tube_journey_count
fields.description: Underground journeys that day, rounded by TfL to the nearest thousand.

fields.name: bus_journey_count
fields.description: Bus journeys that day, rounded by TfL to the nearest thousand.

fields.name: source_file
fields.description: The TfL file this row was taken from, exactly as named in the bucket.

resources.name: raw_zip
resources.description: Every Journeys_*.csv in TfL's Network Demand folder at fetch time, unmodified and under TfL's own filenames, bundled into one deterministic zip.
